info.name: FeastGo API
info.description:
FeastGo food delivery API — auth (customer/seller/delivery/admin), restaurants, menu, orders, coupons, notifications, and admin management.

Set `baseUrl` to your running server (default http://localhost:4000/api). Log in via the relevant Auth folder request, then copy the returned token into the matching collection variable (`token`, `sellerToken`, `deliveryToken`, `adminToken`).

request.description: Demo mode returns the OTP in the request-OTP response; use it here.
